attributes.name: ypy-poll
attributes.description: Options of the smart polling of an element with an `every` trigger: how a hidden tab is polled, and the shortest interval a server may ask for. `false` leaves the element to the core.

values.name: false
values.description: The extension does not touch the polling of this element.

modifiers.name: hidden:<n>
modifiers.description: Factor applied to the interval while the tab is hidden. Default 4.

modifiers.name: hidden:pause
modifiers.description: No polling while the tab is hidden.

modifiers.name: min:<time>
modifiers.description: Shortest interval that a `YPY-Poll-Interval` header may set. Default `100ms`.

events.name: ypy:poll:stop
events.description: Fires on the element when a response with status `286` stopped its polling. The content of that response is swapped as usual.

headers.name: YPY-Poll-Interval
headers.description: Sets the interval of the polling of the element that sent the request, from the next poll on. It stays until another response changes it.
headers.value: milliseconds, or a time such as `5s`, `500ms` or `1m`

config.name: poll
config.description: Default options of the smart polling for the whole page; the `ypy-poll` attribute overrides them per element.

config.name: poll.hidden
config.description: Factor applied to the interval of a poll while the tab is hidden, or `"pause"` to stop polling until the tab is shown.

config.name: poll.min
config.description: Shortest interval a `YPY-Poll-Interval` header may set, in milliseconds or as `"100ms"`.
